patterns: APPSC uses 'which is/are NOT correct' statement sets on 73rd provisions: 18 items is false (29 in Eleventh Schedule), BC reservation voluntary, exemptions Nagaland/Meghalaya/Mizoram, court bar in electoral matters.
APPSC tests Gram Sabha = all registered voters, Gram Sabha as direct democracy, elections within six months, minimum age 21, 1/3 women.
State Finance Commission recurs in APPSC G1/G2 (every 5 years, taxes/tolls/fees, reviews State-local revenue distribution); Union FC role via Art. 280(3)(bb).
Eleventh vs Twelfth Schedule item traps (slaughterhouses, burial grounds, cattle pounds = Twelfth; land-use regulation APPSC key = Eleventh).
App adds many 2026 current-affairs items (awards, SabhaSaar, ZP reorganisation) and match-the-article lists; APPSC keeps to core constitutional provisions.
